   120: `wg-basic system install [--candidate PATH]` installs a local executable;
   121: `wg-basic system status` inspects ownership/service state; and
   122: `wg-basic system uninstall` removes verified owned service/program files while
   123: preserving the state database and service identities for reinstall. Installation
   124: and uninstall require effective root and an active systemd system manager;
   125: canonical destination parents must be root-owned and not group/world writable.
   126: Neither command invokes sudo. Install creates the `wg-basic` identities through
   127: `systemd-sysusers`, installs the canonical `/usr/local/bin` and `[REDACTED_PATH]
   128: layout, and starts netd before the management service. The local install path
   129: performs no release discovery or signature verification. Destructive state
   130: removal remains a separate guarded `state purge`; see the
   131: [installation guide](installation.md).

   133: ## Local administrator credentials
   134: 
   135: Provision or reset the local administrator from the terminal. The same
   136: credentials are what `POST /api/v1/login` exchanges for a session cookie:
   137: 
   138: ```sh
   139: install -d -m 700 [REDACTED_PATH]
   140: printf '%s\n' 'an administrator password' | \
   141:   cargo run --locked -- admin set-password --password-stdin \
   142:     --state [REDACTED_PATH]/state.db
   143: cargo run --locked -- admin status --state [REDACTED_PATH]/state.db
   144: ```
